texts.preamble: Firm Nandkishor Kushwah Through Its ... vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 16 July, 2024 Author: Vijay Kumar Shukla Bench: Vijay Kumar Shukla, Hirdesh
texts.facts: The present petition is filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of India whereby the e-tender submitted by the petitioner for supply of food grains, vegetables, sanitation, stationary, building construction materials and other materials etc. in Central Jail, Indore and District Jail, Indore for financial year 2023-2024 has been rejected on the ground of non-compliance of tender condition no.10 (viii). 2. The respondent no.4 had issued Notice Inviting e-tender for supply of the aforesaid material for financial year 2023-2024 for Central Jail, Indore and District Jail, Indore. The petitioner participated in the tender process and submitted e-tender which has been rejected by the impugned order.
texts.arguments: 3. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that along with the e- tender form, the petitioner has filed copy of license issued by the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India, under FSS Act, 2006. Thus, it is urged that condition no.(viii) of Clause 10 of the tender notice was complied with. 4. Learned counsel for respondents no.1 to 4 submits that the petitioner has filed incomplete copy of the license along with the e-tender form. He has invited attention of this Court to the license filed along with the reply of respondent no.6 as Annexure-A in which at the bottom it is mentioned that the license contained total 6 pages and only first page of the license was filed by the petitioner along with the e-tender form. Thus the tender form was incomplete and even with the writ petition complete copy of license has not been filed. 5. Learned counsel for the respondents submit that the reply was filed by respondents no.1 to 4 on 28.06.2024 and by respondent no.6 on 24.05.2024 respectively, but no complete copy of license has been filed till this date. The petitioner has not filed complete copy of the license which runs into 6 pages and therefore the Committee did not take into consideration the incomplete copy of license. It is further submitted that by filing first page of the license, the condition no.10(viii) has not been complied with and the committee held that the petitioner has not complied with the condition no.10(viii) of the tender. 6.
